=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 572-577. `READ_JOB_LOG_COUNT=$((READ_JOB_LOG_COUNT + 1))` runs after the `filter-log` if/fi block, so it also runs when `filter-log` fails.
  Problem: When `filter-log` fails, the code logs `job_log_filter_failed` and empties `FILTERED_LOG`, yet the log still counts as read. For an issue or pull_request report where every fetched log hits that failure, `READ_JOB_LOG_COUNT` is above 0 and the `error-signature` branch runs on empty files. That produces the `no-error-lines` signature, which is the same for every item. The per-item fallback is skipped, and unrelated items with the same workflow and failing step share a lineage, which is the incident this PR fixes.
  Why it fails at runtime: This needs `filter-log` to exit non-zero on a log that was fetched successfully. That is rare, and the fingerprint is no worse than before the PR. The fix is to move the increment into the success path, for example an `else` on the `if ! ... filter-log` block.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
